calibration_reasons: The learned-null Normal model was identified from the scored selection windows. The curve is conditional on those inputs, not an empirical false-positive rate.
3 scored selection pair(s) overlap and 3 share training rows. Those windows are not independent experiments, and MCMC draws are not independent experiments.
Learned-null prior_scale is the PlaceboInTime default of 1. It is not a noise menu.
historical_replay.audit_note: The audit origin was reserved and not fitted. That is the product's audit reservation. It is not a duration freeze and does not close the selected-duration gap.

eligibility.permitted_claim: Historical replay is descriptive product evidence. It does not carry a binomial standard error, and it is not a launch recommendation.
reasons: Historical windows overlap. The count is product evidence, not a binomial standard error and not an independent experiment.

fold_sd_assessment: Fold standard deviations are posterior standard deviations of the cumulative impact, not residual observation standard deviations and not future observation noise. The effect posterior subtracts counterfactual conditional-mean draws from observed outcomes. Crossing each learned-null draw with every fold standard deviation treats bias and precision as independent. A curve fit on calibration panels does not by itself transport to audit panels or to a future experiment. Numerical exactness of the engine is not qualification.
